title: Robust Filtering of Lévy-driven Stochastic Models
summary: We study robust nonlinear filtering for stochastic models driven by Lévy processes, where the signal and observation processes are coupled through common Brownian and jump noise. Robustness, defined as the continuous dependence of the filter on the observation path, is essential whenever the observation process deviates from the idealized model, for instance when a path must be reconstructed from discrete-time samples.
